Market today: The election results are shaking things up, pushing interest rate expectations around. This is the real driver for tech/chip names, which are already under pressure.

Your holdings: SMCI (-38.29%), SOXL (-81.82%), and MU (-66.07%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the data center narrative, especially with Texas's governor-elect weighing in.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged and deeply underwater positions.
plays: Trim SMCI: If it breaks below its current price, consider cutting losses further.
Trim SOXL: Given the massive drawdown, consider reducing exposure if it shows weakness.
Consider SOXS: If it breaks above its entry (77.67-77.17), it could be a short play against the chip sector.
